sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, gp.RetailPrice AS retailPrice, gp.SalesPrice AS salesPrice, COALESCE(gp.SalesPrice, gp.RetailPrice) AS price, pz.cd AS personalizationCode, br.brandName AS brandName, tb.sd AS shortDescription, tb.ld AS details, tb.sp AS specifications, tb.sh AS shippingInfo, pzl.c1 AS personalization1Code, pzl.l1 AS personalization1Label, pzl.c2 AS personalization2Code, pzl.l2 AS personalization2Label, pzl.c3 AS personalization3Code, pzl.l3 AS personalization3Label FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store CROSS APPLY (SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) AS qty FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory i INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE i.SKU = p.SKU AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId) st CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pr.RetailPrice, pr.SalesPrice FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId = pr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId WHERE pr.SKU = p.SKU AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId, pr.PriceId) gp CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 zpa.AttributeCode AS cd FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue zav INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute zpa ON zpa.PimAttributeId = zav.PimAttributeId WHERE zav.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND zpa.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable AND zpa.AttributeCode = @personalizationAttribute ORDER BY zav.PimAttributeValueId) pz OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 bl.BrandName AS brandName FROM dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails bd INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bl ON bl.BrandId = bd.BrandId WHERE bd.BrandCode = p.Brand AND bl.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY bd.BrandId, bl.BrandDetailLocaleId) br OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @shortDescriptionCode THEN tx.v END) AS sd, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @detailsCode THEN tx.v END) AS ld, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @specificationsCode THEN tx.v END) AS sp, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @shippingInfoCode THEN tx.v END) AS sh FROM (SELECT ta.AttributeCode AS c, COALESCE(tt.AttributeValue, tl.AttributeValue) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue tv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute ta ON ta.PimAttributeId = tv.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue tt ON tt.PimAttributeValueId = tv.PimAttributeValueId AND tt.LocaleId = @localeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale tl ON tl.PimAttributeValueId = tv.PimAttributeValueId AND tl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE tv.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ta.AttributeCode IN (@shortDescriptionCode, @detailsCode, @specificationsCode, @shippingInfoCode)) tx) tb OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN y.rn = @n1 THEN y.c END) AS c1, MAX(CASE WHEN y.rn = @n1 THEN y.l END) AS l1, MAX(CASE WHEN y.rn = @n2 THEN y.c END) AS c2, MAX(CASE WHEN y.rn = @n2 THEN y.l END) AS l2, MAX(CASE WHEN y.rn = @n3 THEN y.c END) AS c3, MAX(CASE WHEN y.rn = @n3 THEN y.l END) AS l3 FROM (SELECT ya.AttributeCode AS c, yl.AttributeName AS l, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ya.DisplayOrder, ya.AttributeCode) AS rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue yv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute ya ON ya.PimAttributeId = yv.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeLocale yl ON yl.PimAttributeId = ya.PimAttributeId AND yl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE yv.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ya.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable) y) pzl WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND st.qty >= @quantityUsed AND gp.RetailPrice > @minPrice AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT rq.PimAddOnProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) AND (@withBrand IS NULL OR br.brandName IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.SKU
